data.content: MRNIU/factorio_LegendaryMechStart shipped the classic “LICENSE + one fix” pair, while EHAPower/dsh-fieldkit committed a docs deletion for a repo whose own README calls it frozen — truly peak archival energy. With 0 PRs, 0 reviews, and 0 issues across both, this week is less development and more commit-message ASMR. Compared to the earlier 23-commit EHA sprint, 3 commits across two unrelated repos sounds like a project powering down, not scaling up.
